name: Waterworks River eastern margin above the railway

shorelineReview.method: Clip only the small source-water overrun east of the inspected five-foot bank line around the 15.2ft dot. Do not add water, change the opposite bank or connect neighbouring ditches.

method: Interpolate three reviewed eastern-margin heights along northing, confined to a 6m strip in the same dry compartment. This narrow strip stays west of the parallel mapped drains. Use a short illustrative water-edge slope so near-edge ground dots retain their actual elevations. Taper into provisional landward ground and at both ends.
limitations: These are local margin observations; no continuous flood-defence crest is established.
The source-water outline is locally reconciled to the native map near the 15.2ft dot; source and corrected geometries remain separately recorded.
The 0.3m shore transition and landward slope are display interpretations, not surveyed bank cross-sections.
Parallel drains and the higher Channelsea bank are excluded from this elevation fit.
Datum conversion, river water and bed levels remain provisional; flood solver unchanged.
